title: Unauthorized access to Hugging Face Spaces secrets
summary: Hugging Face disclosed that it had detected unauthorized access to its Spaces platform and that a subset of the secrets users store for their Spaces may have been accessed. It revoked the Hugging Face tokens found in those secrets and emailed affected users.
attack_vector: Unauthorized access to the platform's store of user-supplied Space secrets (method not disclosed)
impact: A subset of Space secrets (API keys and tokens for users' applications) possibly exposed; affected tokens revoked
mitigations_applied: Revoked exposed tokens, removed organization tokens, added a key management service for Spaces secrets, engaged outside forensic specialists, reported to law enforcement and data protection authorities, and advised users to refresh keys and move to fine-grained tokens
